title: gnosis: web scraping to LLM-ready Markdown with byte-level provenance
description: gnosis fetches and crawls web pages and converts them to clean, LLM/RAG-ready Markdown with byte-level provenance: SHA-256 over the raw response bytes, WARC archival, a content-addressed store, an IP-pinned SSRF guard, token-aware chunking with citation spans, ai.txt/llms.txt consent recording, a compliance policy engine, Ed25519 signing (seal of origin), multi-format export (JSON/JSONL/Parquet), an MCP server, and plugin hooks. Its thesis: Markdown is a projection; the raw bytes + WARC are the source of truth.
